Seven of those 15 non-passes have no provider content at all (5 verifier-graded model outcomes, 3 declared specification gaps, minus one counted twice; see admission.nonProviderCells), one is a pre-model image pull recorded as error and recovered by config/frontier-harness-recovery-anko-40257143514-20261026.json, and four carry an explicit provider failure above the predeclared threshold. Only those four are re-measured here.

admission.rule: AGENTS.md:11 — a declared re-measurement is the only way an already-graded cell may be measured again, and it never replaces the verdict it re-measures. Each of the four cells below carries a canonical verdict from run 40257143514 (disposition=failed with a verifier-graded rewards object), so none is recovered: each receives exactly one extra attempt, under the same candidate, the same provider and effort, the same per-cell official budget, the same grader and the same generation composition as the source run. No cell receives a second extra attempt.
admission.class: variance check — the cell's own frozen evidence carries an explicit provider failure (transport error or model-invocation timeout) that consumed at least 10% of that cell's declared agent budget; the source verdict stands and is not replaced, and the extra attempt asks whether the same frozen composition reproduces the same terminal state or whether the provider contention was the difference

threshold.declaredBeforeDispatch: cumulative duration of entries whose evidence type is model-failure and whose failure.reason is transport or a timeout, divided by the cell's own effectiveAgentTimeoutSec, at least 0.10
threshold.whyThisThreshold: It separates a stall that could plausibly decide a cell from incidental noise inside a 900-5400 s budget. It is stated as a number before dispatch so the cell set cannot be chosen after seeing which cells a re-run favours; the two below-threshold cells and their exact shares are disclosed instead of dropped.

admission.measurement: For every cell of the source run, the evidence JSONL named by its artifacts was read from the run's own report artifact and every entry of type model-failure was summed by failure.reason. Budgets are the cell's own effectiveAgentTimeoutSec from its frozen record. Nothing was re-run or re-read from a log outside the artifact.

provider.note: Identical to the source run: same model, same effort, same gateway, same credential.

mitigation.imageMirror: The same seven digest-preserving GHCR mirrors the source run declared are passed unchanged. The three rechecked terminal-bench cells resolve alexgshaw/* images from Docker Hub and scc resolves a mirrored public.ecr.aws image, so no cell here can hit the anonymous-pull 429 that produced the source run's single error.
mitigation.noBudgetChange: No budget, timeout, effort or parallelism per cell is extended for this re-measurement; fh_agent_timeout_multiplier stays 1. If the provider stalls again inside the same budget, that is the measurement this manifest exists to take.
mitigation.noCleanClaim: Public egress and no contamination gate, so this batch claims no cell was clean.

constraints: One extra attempt per admitted cell, never a second chance at that attempt.
No verdict, frozen record or artifact of run 40257143514 or any earlier run is replaced, repaired or reinterpreted; the repaired reading is a companion published beside the run.
The source run's passAt1 stays null; this batch publishes no pass@1 of its own.
No budget, timeout or effort is extended to make any cell scoreable.
The ten cells listed under admission.nonProviderCells are not re-run by this manifest.
Every attempt's terminal state is recorded with its own evidence hash; a cell that stalls again keeps the new verdict and is not retried.

knownRisks.providerMayStallAgain: The likeliest outcome for the three strongest cells is a second provider stall inside the same budget. That is a valid result: it would show the verdict is provider-sensitive rather than reproducible, and it does not become a capability reading either way.
knownRisks.varianceIsNotCausation: A flip on re-measurement shows the verdict is not stable under the provider conditions of this period; it does not by itself attribute the original failure.
knownRisks.codeFromImageIsWeakest: That cell's stall is 12.4% of budget and the attempt used all of it, so a flip there is the least informative of the four and is disclosed as such in its own entry.
knownRisks.noContaminationGate: Public egress and no gate: a cell that reaches its upstream solution is not detected here.
knownRisks.classificationOfDeadlineKills: The source run's failure analysis labels chess-best-move and code-from-image infra, which their records contradict (normal model calls, one transport stall, killed at the cell's own deadline). This manifest uses the records, not that label.

plannedChecks: After the batch: read the aggregate report, confirm coverage of exactly the four predeclared cells, confirm one candidate and one provider, compare each cell's disposition to the source verdict, and read every non-passing cell's own evidence again to state its mechanical cause. Then publish the repaired reading beside the frozen record with scripts/frontier-harness-repaired-reading.mjs --official, which keeps passAt1 null and discloses both verdicts and the extra-attempt count.
